name: Laura Agostino
headline: ERP & NetSuite Consulting Professional | Process Optimization • Systems Integration • Client Enablement
about:
Helping organizations streamline financial operations, optimize processes, and get real value from their NetSuite and ERP systems.

I specialize in NetSuite and ERP consulting, helping organizations streamline financial operations, strengthen accounting processes, and implement systems that scale with growth.

With a background in accounting and a passion for process design, I focus on translating business needs into practical, efficient solutions that teams can sustain. My approach combines hands-on implementation experience with a strong focus on client enablement and service delivery excellence.

I’m committed to simplifying complexity, driving clarity, and helping businesses get real value from their systems — not just at go-live, but long after.
… more

experiences.description:
In my pivotal role as Consulting Manager at Nuage, I spearhead the Services Consulting Team with a focus on delivering exceptional service to our NetSuite customers. 

Strategic Solution Design: I collaborate closely with clients to understand their specific business challenges and opportunities, designing and implementing NetSuite solutions that are customized to their unique operational environment.

Team Leadership and Development: I mentor and guide a talented team of consultants, fostering an environment of continuous learning and innovation. 

Client Relationship Management: I maintain and deepen client relationships by ensuring that our service exceeds expectations. 

Project Oversight: Overseeing multiple project implementations simultaneously, I ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. This involves detailed project planning, risk management, and regular client updates to keep all stakeholders aligned.

Continuous Improvement: I actively seek out feedback from clients and team members to refine our approach, ensuring that our solutions not only meet current business needs but also adapt to future demands. 

My goal is to ensure that every NetSuite implementation not only solves immediate issues but also positions our clients for long-term success in their respective industries. Through tailored strategies and innovative technology use, I aim to transform challenges into opportunities for growth.
